title: Multiple Emitter Location and Signal Parameter Estimation
venue: IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation
abstract: Original MUSIC formulation; baseline subspace DOA method that later coherent-source work modifies because coherent sources can make the covariance rank deficient.

title: On Spatial Smoothing for Direction-of-Arrival Estimation of Coherent Signals
authors: T.-J. Shan; M. Wax; T. Kailath
venue: IEEE Transactions on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
abstract: Classic spatial smoothing paper for coherent-signal DOA; directly relevant to restoring rank before applying MUSIC.

title: Forward/Backward Spatial Smoothing Techniques for Coherent Signal Identification
authors: S. U. Pillai; B. H. Kwon
venue: IEEE Transactions on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
abstract: Forward-backward smoothing extension; close to the FBSS/MSSP logic in the local codebase.

title: Direction Finding of Coherent Signals via Spatial Smoothing for Uniform Circular Arrays
venue: IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation
abstract: Adapts spatial smoothing ideas to circular arrays; relevant because the current algorithm works on a cylindrical/circular-column geometry rather than a pure ULA.

title: Superresolution of Coherent Sources by Using a Cylindrical Array Antenna with the Spatial Smoothing Technique
authors: M. D. Zoltowski; T. Mathews; S. Y. Kung
abstract: Very relevant by array type: coherent-source superresolution using cylindrical array plus spatial smoothing. Needs manual retrieval for full details.

title: A Beamspace Transform for UCA: Error Analysis and Bias Reduction
abstract: Beamspace transform and UCA error/bias considerations; useful background for why local true-geometry/shared-center steering may be preferable to a broad approximate transform.

title: Improved Spatial Differencing Scheme for 2-D DOA Estimation of Coherent Signals Using Uniform Rectangular Arrays
authors: H. Chen; W. Wang; W. Liu
abstract: 2D coherent-source DOA approach using spatial differencing; maps to the current large-elevation branch using 2D information rather than layer-2 compression.

title: Two-Dimensional Direction-of-Arrival Estimation of Coherent Signals Using Two Parallel Uniform Linear Arrays
authors: D. Shi; X. Yang; X. Li; Q. Huang
venue: EURASIP Journal on Wireless Communications and Networking
abstract: 2D coherent DOA using structured arrays; relevant to branch C and pair-local refinement concepts.

title: Direction-of-Arrival Estimation for Circulating Space-Time Coding Arrays: From Beamspace MUSIC to Spatial Smoothing in Transform Domain
authors: L. Wang; L. Wan; G. Han; S. Chan; T. Zhu
abstract: Shows a path from beamspace MUSIC to spatial smoothing in a transformed domain; relevant to using transform/local subspace processing for coherent sources.

title: Grid-Less DOA Estimation of Coherent Sources Based on the Covariance Matrix Recovery
authors: Z. Wu; Z. Huang; Y. Zhou; J. Wu
abstract: Covariance-matrix recovery for coherent sources; relevant as a future alternative to rank1/covfit fallback, but likely heavier than the current engineering cascade.

title: An Enhanced DOA Estimation Method for Coherent Sources via Toeplitz Matrix Reconstruction and Khatri-Rao Subspace
authors: Y. Qi; H. Zhang; H. Zhu; H. Wang
abstract: Recent covariance reconstruction plus Khatri-Rao subspace method; useful comparison for coherent-source rank restoration beyond standard smoothing.

title: An Enhanced Spatial Smoothing Technique of Coherent DOA Estimation with Moving Coprime Array
authors: K. Yang; Z. Zhao; X. Zhang; Y. Sun
abstract: Improves spatial smoothing for coherent DOA with moving coprime arrays; relevant to the idea that smoothing can be engineered for aperture/complexity tradeoffs.

title: DOA Estimation Based on Improved Spatial-Smoothing Technique
authors: Y. Wang; L. Shi; Y. Li; X. Ma; Y. Wang
abstract: Improved smoothing and covariance usage for coherent sources; useful as a recent comparison point for low-complexity coherent-source MUSIC enhancement.
